premises.text: A fundability score compares a company's data to past successful and unsuccessful capital raises and suggests improvements
premises.evidence_span: This is a score that looks at a company's data and compares it with the data of companies that have successfully and unsuccessfully raised capital in the past

premises.text: The score is built from a large private-offering dataset combining Australian ASSOB data with other U.S. and global databases
premises.evidence_span: we took the largest data set of small private offerings in the world, which is the Australian Small Scale Offering Board's data set, and we layered in data from other US and global databases

premises.text: Signup is free; platform deals pay a 2% success fee via broker-dealer, with optional higher full-service banking fees
premises.evidence_span: For investors or issuers to sign up on the site, it's free. For any deals that transact on the platform, we take a 2% success fee

premises.text: Global deal inventory and investor participation come through partnerships with platforms, brokers, and significant investors
premises.evidence_span: We've made partnerships with global platforms, deal sourcers, and brokers to bring in deals from multiple countries

value.text: Companies improve fundability and connect with investors to raise private capital
